trainingOptions.name: Dig
trainingOptions.text: If the trainer passes an Average (+2 SL) Animal Training Test the animal will dig in a certain spot, on command. This might help make pit traps, or uncover buried items.
trainingOptions.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use core Appendix I SL modifiers.

trainingOptions.name: Heel
trainingOptions.text: If the trainer passes an Average (+2 SL) Animal Training Test the animal comes to heel immediately when commanded, whatever the distraction.
trainingOptions.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use core Appendix I SL modifiers.

trainingOptions.name: Hunt
trainingOptions.text: If the trainer passes an Average (+2 SL) Animal Training Test the animal will pursue a quarry, then attempt to kill it and retrieve it. You can use a Challenging (+0 SL) Melee Test to determine whether it is successful.
trainingOptions.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use core Appendix I SL modifiers.

trainingOptions.name: Point
trainingOptions.text: The animal points reliably to the item sought by the trainer provided that that item has a distinctive scent. This is used for indicating a quarry and is also useful for pointing out contraband. Some dogs are very ostentatious in their pointing, but others can do this more subtly.

trainingOptions.name: Round
trainingOptions.text: If the trainer passes an Challenging (+0 SL) Animal Training Test the animal is able to position itself to manipulate the quarry to move in a certain way, without spooking it. This can also be used for activities like herding.
trainingOptions.adaptation: Named Fourth Edition Test Difficulties use core Appendix I SL modifiers.

trainingOptions.name: Track
trainingOptions.text: The animal has the Tracker Trait, and will perform it on command with instructions: for example, searching for and following a scent it has been given a sample of.

adaptation: Printed Stride uses core Sprinter (p. 361): Run Movement ×1.5 when Running.

trainingOptions.name: Return
trainingOptions.text: Hawks usually return to their handler, but can be recalcitrant. With this trait the handler is allowed to make a Charm Animal Test opposed by the hawk’s WP , to have it return immediately and without complications.
